creator: Alexander Terp
description:
GitHub issue #1 (amterp, 2026-10-07), parts 1, 3 and 4, from Codex CLI 0.160.1 in Muster 0.14.0 panes on the laptop and a Linux devenv:

1. Codex's managed app-server runs tool commands outside the pane. Shared and long-lived on macOS, it keeps the first session's MUSTER_PANE / MUSTER_SOCKET, so later sessions report as a dead pane. Per session on Linux, it is in its own process group under the name `codex`, so the daemon refuses its reports as "another codex". `daemon_auto_start = false` under `[features]` in ~/.codex/config.toml fixes both.
3. Codex's "Hooks need review" startup dialog reads as idle, so a director's brief lands behind it.
4. `muster harness install codex` registers ~/.muster/daemon/<version>/extras where Claude Code gets the ~/.muster/extras symlink, so the Codex adapter goes stale on every upgrade.

Part 2 is its own card. The issue text is the full account.
title: 🧩 Codex 0.160 in a pane: its app-server acts as the wrong pane, its startup dialogs read idle, its adapter path goes stale
